text: Stepping into this world of glass, color, and innovation, I feel a sense of anticipation and curiosity. The sterile, modern design of the hallway contrasts with the vibrant, inviting display of R+D — a space dedicated to inquiry and creativity. Here, the boundaries of intellect and imagination blur, and I feel both small in the face of human advancement and inspired by the collective pursuit of knowledge. It’s as though I stand at the threshold of possibilities, where contemplation and progress intertwine.
